post.title: How Ryanair profits on a fare of about €51
post.ig:
Ryanair's average fare was about €51 in fiscal 2026. So how does it profit?

In fiscal 2026 (year to March 2026), Ryanair flew 208.4 million passengers and earned €15.54 billion in revenue.
Extras like bags and seats brought in €4.99 billion, about €24 per passenger and about a third of revenue.
Low costs: mostly Boeing 737s, secondary airports, 25-minute turnarounds, and planes 94% full.
Profit after tax was a record €2.26 billion before one-off items, about €11 per passenger.

Sources: Ryanair FY2026 results (May 2026) and annual reports.
